reviews.author: Neamat Almasri
reviews.text: The best PT center in town! Visiting from the US and in urgent need of PT, finding Dr. Najah and her outstanding team was truly a lifesaver. Exceptional care and professionalism. So grateful to the entire team! Highly recommend! ❤️

reviews.author: Bayan Ashrafi
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this physiotherapy center! From the moment you walk in, you are welcomed by a wonderful, clean, and positive atmosphere. The entire team is incredibly kind and attentive. A special and heartfelt thank you to Dr. Najah and Dr. Areej

they gave me their full concentration, listened closely to my concerns, and conducted thorough, precise diagnostic tests to find the exact issue. Their care and attention to detail made all the difference in my recovery. Everything about this place is excellent!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you wishing you continued health and wellness.

reviews.author: Talah Baytam
reviews.text:
I went to Royal Care Physiotherapy center with severe back pain and muscle spasms throughout my entire back. I could barely walk, I was losing my balance, and my muscles were very weak. I was in a really bad condition.

From the moment I started treatment here, everything changed. Dr. Najah and Dr. Elhan helped me so much. They worked carefully on all the weak points in my body and truly understood my pain. Their professionalism, knowledge, and kindness made a huge difference in my recovery.

The entire team is amazing — from the receptionist to the doctors. Everyone is welcoming, respectful, and genuinely caring. You feel supported the moment you walk in.

I am extremely grateful to this center and especially to Dr. Najah and Dr. Elhan. Thank you all so much for everything you’ve done for me. I truly appreciate you and highly recommend this place.
reviews.owner_reply: We’re so happy you enjoyed your visit,thanks for the great review.

reviews.author: habib ullah
reviews.text:
I have been suffering from back pain for a year because of a car accident. I did many physiotherapies However, the royal physiotherapy treatment was way different and more efficient than the others. I had over 10 sessions with Royal Physiotherapy. I felt the difference after the third therapy. My lower back pain and sciatica had put me almost into depression. But now, after receiving the therapy I feel much better.
I was visiting Dubai. I found Royal Physiotherapy on Google. When I went there for treatment it was a life changer for me. I am very happy that I went there for my treatment. I can’t say how much thankful I am to all the staff and workers there, specifically doctor Mohamad. They’re very sympathetic, professional, and experienced. They are the people who feel your pain as we say that “you have to believe in order to receive”. They believed in our treatment and I received the best treatment and services from them. I would like to thank everyone at the Royal Physiotherapy from the bottom of my heart. I highly recommend Royal Physiotherapy.
